entries.speaker: Police Director
entries.en: Did the remaining members put that[n]notice out!?

entries.speaker: Police Director
entries.en: What did they mean when they said[n]"nobody has died"!?
entries.uk: Що вони мали на увазі, кажучи,[n]що «ніхто не помер»!?

entries.speaker: Police Director
entries.en: Could they have installed a new leader[n]just to threaten us and Shido!?
entries.uk: Може, вони поставили нового ватажка,[n]аби просто погрожувати нам і Шідо!?

entries.speaker: Chief Detective
entries.en: We're going to check with the different[n]departments...

entries.speaker: Chief Detective
entries.en: The phantom thief's corpse seems to be[n]missing from the morgue!
entries.uk: Схоже, тіло фантомного злодія зникло[n]з моргу!

entries.speaker: Police Director
entries.en: Didn't your men check the death[n]certificate and carrier documents!?
entries.uk: Хіба ваші люди не перевіряли свідоцтво[n]про смерть і супровідні документи!?

entries.speaker: Chief Detective
entries.en: Perhaps this phantom thief tricked us[n]with his bizarre powers!
entries.uk: Може, цей фантомний злодій обдурив нас[n]своїми дивними силами!

entries.speaker: Chief Detective
entries.en: Maybe he just made us think he had died...
entries.uk: Може, він просто змусив нас повірити,[n]що помер...

entries.speaker: Police Director
entries.en: Who was there at the scene of the[n]suicide!?
